newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovers slightly on commercial dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovers slightly on commercial dlr sales.

text.p: * Ringgit recovers from overnight lows on commercial dollar selling from Kuala Lumpur
* Seen in narrow range in first few days of new year
* Strong dollar/yen to keep ringgit subdued
* Volumes stay low on last trading day of year
The ringgit recovered from overnight lows on commercial dollar sales by exporters based in Kuala Lumpur, dealers said on Tuesday.
However, it was stuck in a narrow range in late morning Asian trading as volumes dropped further due to holiday in Tokyo and account closing at many banks on last day of the year.
"The movement was commercial driven. Most of the trades were done around 2.5280," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
He said most of the deals had been absorbed by the market and volume was beginning to decline towards noon.
Dealers said the ringgit would remain rangebound over the next few days as banks prepare to open new positions in 1997.
At 0300 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5273/83 a dollar.
